command_denied.en: [FakeCheats] This server command is not whitelisted. Only @css/root can bypass this restriction.
command_denied.zhcn: [FakeCheats] 此服务端命令不在白名单内；仅 @css/root 可绕过限制。

status_summary.en: [FakeCheats] fakecheats_enabled={0}; real server sv_cheats={1}; client spoof={2}; access={3}
status_summary.zhcn: [FakeCheats] 假作弊开关={0}；真实服务端 sv_cheats={1}；客户端伪装={2}；权限={3}

world_pending.en: [FakeCheats] The map is not ready. Synchronization will start automatically after world initialization.
world_pending.zhcn: [FakeCheats] 地图尚未就绪，将在游戏世界初始化后自动同步。

sync_done.en: [FakeCheats] Client sv_cheats={0} has been sent again. Real server sv_cheats remains 0.
sync_done.zhcn: [FakeCheats] 已重新发送客户端 sv_cheats={0}；真实服务端保持 0。

switch_denied.en: [FakeCheats] Only @css/root or the server console can change the global switch.
switch_denied.zhcn: [FakeCheats] 全服开关仅供 @css/root 或服务端使用。

switch_changed.en: [FakeCheats] Global visual fake cheats are {0}. Real server sv_cheats remains 0.
switch_changed.zhcn: [FakeCheats] 全服视觉假作弊已{0}，真实服务端 sv_cheats 保持 0。

noclip_denied.en: [FakeCheats] Noclip is available only to in-game players with @css/root.
noclip_denied.zhcn: [FakeCheats] 穿墙仅供游戏内 @css/root 使用。

noclip_usage.en: [FakeCheats] Usage: noclip or css_fc_noclip (run again to turn it off).
noclip_usage.zhcn: [FakeCheats] 用法：noclip 或 css_fc_noclip（再次执行关闭）。

noclip_alive_required.en: [FakeCheats] The map must be ready and you must be alive to use noclip.
noclip_alive_required.zhcn: [FakeCheats] 请在地图就绪、玩家存活时使用穿墙。

exec_denied.en: [FakeCheats] This command is available only to in-game players with @css/root.
exec_denied.zhcn: [FakeCheats] 此命令仅供游戏内 @css/root 使用。

exec_usage.en: [FakeCheats] Usage: css_fc_exec <one server command and its arguments>, for example css_fc_exec noclip. Semicolons and line breaks are not allowed.
exec_usage.zhcn: [FakeCheats] 用法：css_fc_exec <一个服务端命令及参数>，例如 css_fc_exec noclip；不接受分号或换行。

exec_noclip_usage.en: [FakeCheats] Usage: css_fc_exec noclip (run again to turn it off).
exec_noclip_usage.zhcn: [FakeCheats] 用法：css_fc_exec noclip（再次执行关闭）。

exec_submitted.en: [FakeCheats] Server command submitted. Its effect depends on the engine and the command's own checks.
exec_submitted.zhcn: [FakeCheats] 已提交服务端命令；是否生效由引擎及命令自身检查决定。

description_sync.en: Re-send the current client sv_cheats value
description_sync.zhcn: 重新发送当前客户端 sv_cheats 值

description_exec.en: ROOT: dispatch one server command in your player context
description_exec.zhcn: ROOT：以自己的玩家上下文执行一个服务端命令

description_noclip.en: ROOT: toggle noclip without enabling real sv_cheats
description_noclip.zhcn: ROOT：不启用真实 sv_cheats，直接切换穿墙

log_loaded.en: FakeCheats {0} loaded: real sv_cheats=0; waiting for a world update before accessing players.
log_loaded.zhcn: FakeCheats {0} 已加载：真实 sv_cheats=0；等待游戏世界更新后再读取玩家。

log_real_cheats_reset.en: Real sv_cheats was enabled externally; resetting it to 0.
log_real_cheats_reset.zhcn: 外部配置或插件启用了真实 sv_cheats，正在重置为 0。

log_sync_postponed.en: Player synchronization postponed: CS2 global variables are not available.
log_sync_postponed.zhcn: CS2 全局变量尚不可用，已推迟玩家同步。

log_native_noclip_ready.en: Native noclip access enabled. Player requests require @css/root; real sv_cheats remains 0.
log_native_noclip_ready.zhcn: 原生 noclip 入口已启用；玩家请求需有 @css/root，真实 sv_cheats 保持 0。

log_native_noclip_failed.en: Native noclip access could not be enabled on this engine build. css_fc_noclip remains available to root.
log_native_noclip_failed.zhcn: 当前引擎版本无法启用原生 noclip 入口，root 仍可使用 css_fc_noclip。

log_language_file_failed.en: Could not load language file '{0}'. Built-in messages will be used.
log_language_file_failed.zhcn: 无法加载语言文件“{0}”，将使用内置提示。
